WERDYKT: JLP = nierozstrzygnęte, prawdopodobnie zawyżone — wymaga regresji 3-czynnikowej z SOL

perQuestion.answer: The backtests for JLP (Jupiter, Solana) from November 2023 to September 2026 (1019 days) showed a mix 90/30 average of +6.52%/window and a total period return of +211% (+50%/r), with an alpha (α) of +20.6%/r (66% after correction). However, the maximum drawdown (maxDD) was 46.0%, which failed the criterion as it was greater than the basket's 42.9%. The verdict was that JLP results were "nierozstrzygnięte, prawdopodobnie zawyżone" because the SOL rally likely inflated the alpha, necessitating a 3-factor regression including SOL.
